rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for administration as the running or management of affairs.

example.english: The administration of this shop is pretty good.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭嘅管理做得幾好。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 ge3 gun2 lei5 zou6 dak1 gei2 hou2

rows.note: Use this when administration means the government or cabinet currently in office.

example.english: The administration said it would review the housing policy again.
example.traditional: 政府話會再檢討房屋政策。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 waa6 wui5 zoi3 gim2 tou2 fong4 uk1 zing3 caak3

rows.note: Use this for an organization or body whose role is to administer something.

example.english: This administration handles maintenance for the housing estate.
example.traditional: 呢個管理機構專門處理屋苑維修。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gun2 lei5 gei1 kau3 zyun1 mun4 cyu2 lei5 uk1 jyun2 wai4 sau1

rows.note: Use this when administration means giving medicine or treatment, especially medication.

example.english: The doctor told me to follow the medication administration instructions.
example.traditional: 醫生叫我跟足用藥指示。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 giu3 ngo5 gan1 zuk1 jung6 joek6 zi2 si6
